content.short: 1st Cardano Blockchain integrated Algorithmic Composition Inspired by Musicians & Sound Enthusiasts.
content.description:
The past two years have been rough, the world was affected by a series of events in multiple ways. Some of them are minor, some major. We are music and sound enthusiasts, for some this is their hobby, for others their sole focus and passion.

The global pandemic kept most of the artists and musicians out of (non-digital) touch with their fan base and those who consider themselves lucky to work in this industry, out of work for months on end. Luckily, technology has greatly assisted to close this gap.

This is where the spark ignited for us, as technologists as well as music and sound enthusiasts we were able to collaborate with musicians and artists to create MusicBox. A hand-crafted collection of the best sounds and bits from the best instruments known to mankind. From Korg Polysix, to the rare Linn Drum, all sounds were recorded using industry-standard chains. Our algorithm was written with melody and randomness in mind to create unique and yet familiar compositions to touch both familiar and unfamiliar ears. And with the blockchain technology of Cardano, these sounds and melodies will be preserved and exchanged by fellow music and sound enthusiasts.

We will also be donating to carefully selected artists as well as larger organizations that help preserve music and push people to pursue their passion, especially in these times.

We hope you will enjoy this project as much as we do.
